llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文直接研究激光冲击和喷丸后处理对Ti-6Al-4V疲劳性能的影响，符合方向聚焦。
llm.why_not_core: No experimental mechanical data; purely simulation-based study lacks experimental validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究激光冲击和喷丸协同处理对钛合金疲劳性能的影响。
summary_zh.method: 采用仿真和预测方法分析后处理对微结构及疲劳寿命的作用。
summary_zh.result: 揭示了协同处理显著提升疲劳寿命的机制。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值仿真与文献数据对比验证模型准确性。

summary_en.motivation: Investigate the synergistic effect of laser shock peening and shot peening on fretting fatigue behavior of Ti-6Al-4V dovetail joints.
summary_en.method: Developed a simulation framework integrating residual stress and microstructure evolution to predict fatigue life under combined peening treatments.
summary_en.result: The synergistic treatment produced deeper compressive residual stress and enhanced fatigue resistance compared to single peening methods.
summary_en.validation: Validated the simulation results against published experimental data and fretting fatigue test benchmarks.
